name: uptime-kuma
description: Uptime Kuma (SQLite, WAL): the data volume (kuma.db + uploads) is captured as a file copy - crash-consistent, which SQLite WAL recovers from; worst case is losing the last seconds of heartbeat history. No SQL detection applies (embedded DB) - 'No database detected' at create is expected. 2FA secrets and notification configs are inside the DB; restore = folder/volume back, 'up -d'.
